audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagree with the prose beneath them — Level 1 is Cassiopeia while whys[0] says neither side threatens a kill; Levels 4-5 and first item read Skill while whys[3] calls 4-5 'her control peak' and whys[5] says her AP item beats your tank piece; and 2+ items reads Cassiopeia while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all call it your reclaim window.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Cassiopeia x5, K'Sante) matches the prose on every one of those rows.
audit.corrected: NOT CHANGED. The mirror audit recorded 'No side changes' and deliberately left the same 2+ items contradiction open rather than flipping it; flipping from this side alone would put the two pages in conflict. Raised in questionsForUser instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere on the spike that decides the lane.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 falling to 16s — the single longest gap you get to walk through — and Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s. Twin Fang fires every 0.75s, which is why the poke war is unwinnable.
audit.corrected: All three written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[2].text and dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: MISSING INTERACTION: nothing said Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies FACING her. The page also called Ntofo Strikes a 'Q3 knock-up' and said Miasma 'cancels my W mid-charge'.
audit.why: Riot's text: enemies in front of her that are facing her are stunned, others with their back turned are only slowed. Turning away converts her ultimate from a stun into a slow — the single most actionable thing on this page. Miasma grounds: grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities, so your W dash and E do not fire at all; that is a denial, not a mid-cast cancel. Ntofo Strikes shockwaves at TWO stacks and pulls.
audit.corrected: The facing rule written into spikes[2].text, wants.foe[2] and breakdown.cooldowns; grounding restated as denial in early, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns; pull replaces knock-up in early and tradeGood.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds despite Twin Fang healing off every poisoned target.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of damage dealt on a 0.75s cooldown, so a long lane grind sustains her for free.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to wants.you[2] and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then wall-stun him on the Miasma cooldown and All Out the 1v1. K'Sante wins the Miasma cooldown windows.
edits.after: She kites you out — survive, then wall-stun her on the Miasma cooldown and All Out the 1v1. K'Sante wins the Miasma cooldown windows.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Miasma: 24s at rank 1 down to 16s — grounded, your W dash and E do not fire. - Petrifying Gaze: 120s, and it only stuns if you are facing her. - Twin Fang: 0.75s, and it heals her — buy Grievous Wounds. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Chain Q slows on Cassiopeia, Q3-knockup when his answer is down, W through the return damage, and decide: peel out or All Out.
edits.after: Chain Q slows on Cassiopeia, two stacks to pull her in once Miasma is spent, W through the return poke, then peel out or All Out.

edits.before: That is Cassiopeia's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Twin Fang fires every 0.75s and heals her off it — a whiffed W just feeds her ramp.

edits.before: Her R face-stun catches you mid-W and her grounds cancel your E dash — landing a clean wall-stun W on her is your only kill condition all lane.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (120s) only stuns you if you face her — turn away and it is a slow, so landing a wall-stun W is still your kill condition.

edits.before: Land R face-stun the instant you commit your W charge, then walk away and re-poison
edits.after: Land Petrifying Gaze while you face her, so it stuns instead of slowing, then re-poison

edits.before: Buy Mercury's Treads and an early magic-resist piece so her poison ticks do not bleed you out of lane
edits.after: Buy Mercury's Treads and Grievous Wounds early — Twin Fang heals her off every poison tick you eat

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are the only stretch that is mine. Cassio is poison-only and ramps slowly, so I can walk up, eat one Q, and threaten a Q3 knock-up before her DPS exists. The moment Twin Fang is online at 3, that flips: she shreds me at range and my Q barely reaches. Last-hit at the tip of Q, do not chase a Q she can just kite, and never step over her Miasma — the ground cancels my W mid-charge and strands me in her poison.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are the only stretch that is mine. Cassio is poison-only and ramps slowly, so I can walk up, eat one Q, and threaten the two-stack pull before her DPS exists. The moment Twin Fang is online at 3, that flips: she shreds me at range and my Q barely reaches. Last-hit at the tip of Q, do not chase a Q she can just kite, and never step over her Miasma — grounded, my W dash and E do not fire and I am stuck in her poison.

notes: Highest-value find: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her and merely slows anyone with their back turned. The page never said it, and turning away is a free downgrade of her ultimate.
